Limit[n=20]
  Sort[keys=lineitem.extended_price DESC, lineitem_id ASC]
    Project[lineitem.id AS lineitem_id, orders.id AS order_id, customer.name AS cust_name, customer.nation AS nation, lineitem.extended_price AS extended_price]
      Filter[customer.mktsegment = 'BUILDING' AND orders.order_priority = '1-URGENT']
        Join[kind=inner, cond=orders.cust_id = customer.id]
          Join[kind=inner, cond=lineitem.order_id = orders.id]
            Scan[lineitem]
            Scan[orders]
          Scan[customer]
